entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Oh right, today's Valentine's Day.[n]No wonder there were so many guys[n]bringing girls in here.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Don't you have anything exciting[n]happening? I mean, you've been here[n]nearly a whole year.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Y'know, when I was young, hoo boy...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Good evening...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Should I come back later?

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Ohhh... You should've just told me.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Here, I'll leave the store to you.

entries.speaker: Sojiro
entries.en: Enjoy yourselves...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: You seem to be doing well.
Have a seat.
I'll make you some coffee.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Sure...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: It's nice to see you again. You don't[n]look like you've got any issues...
I feel fine.
Hard to say.
I missed you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Really. I can't relate.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I can always give you a more thorough[n]checkup.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But before that...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That's my line.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Suicide in jail? Then New Year's in the[n]reformatory? Ex post facto isn't exactly[n]gonna cover this, you know.
Sorry.
My bad.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Honestly. Can't take my eyes off you[n]for a second.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...But I guess I'd better get to the point.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Here...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Chocolates. Don't worry, there's nothing[n]too dangerous in them.
I'll eat it with care.
Handmade?
Glad I didn't miss this.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: In moderation, right?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Sadly, no. Were you hoping for that?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I figured worst-case scenario, I could[n]probably get it into prison for you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: That new medicine, for that girl I told[n]you about, has been working really well.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: And the day-to-day work's going fine.[n]I'm a regular neighborhood doctor[n]now.
Glad to hear that.
It suits you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Thanks.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I just hoped you were safe, but... looks[n]like you made it home without a scratch.[n]Guess I had nothing to worry about.
I should tell Takemi that[n]I'm going home...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Something wrong?
I'll be returning to my hometown.
I'm going home.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I see...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Can I sit next to you?

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I know that look in your eyes.[n]You've made up your mind.
Will you miss me?
I'll visit as soon as I can.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Maybe a little.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Maybe a lot. I can't lie to you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: No rush. You can hold off until things[n]settle down a little.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But if anything happens, call me.[n]You know how to reach me.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: By the way, something's... different[n]about you.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Hasn't been too long since I saw you[n]last, but... you've got a little more[n]confidence now, or something.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: ...Still. I guess I've changed too.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: As a doctor, I've still got the usual[n]obligations to help my patients, but...

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: Now I feel like I've got something a[n]little more specific. Like I could risk[n]it all to make one person happy.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: But you're a smart guy. I don't have[n]to draw you a picture.
Yeah. I get it.

entries.speaker: Takemi
entries.en: I was never really into younger guys...
I spent a romantic evening[n]with Takemi...
